newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz eyes tie-up with Tyson, Purina unit.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz eyes tie-up with Tyson, Purina unit.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc said on Monday its Pilmico Foods Corp subsidiary is planning to form a joint venture with U.S.-based firms Tyson Foods Inc and PM Nutrition Company Inc.
They intend to establish integrated feedmilling and swine operations for the Philippine market at a projected cost of about $25 million, Aboitiz said in a statement.
Tyson Foods Inc is a large poultry processor, while PM Nutrition Company is a wholly-owned unit of Purina Mills Inc, a big producer of commercial animal feeds in the U.S.
Aboitiz said Pilmico is currently finalising the terms of the joint venture. The project is expected to start before the end of the year.
Aboitiz is a holding company also engaged in power, banking and financial services.
